%% =====================================================================
%% KSA / KFU - CCSIT Graduation Project Report Template
%% PREAMBLE  --  DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE
%% ---------------------------------------------------------------------
%% This file holds the fixed layout of the report: packages, fonts,
%% margins, header and footer, code-listing style, and section
%% numbering. It is loaded from main.tex with \input{ccsit-preamble}.
%%
%% Everything you need to change is in ccsit-macros.tex, in the block headed
%% "CCSIT / KFU MACROS (EDIT THESE)".
%% =====================================================================

%% ----------------------------- Language & Fonts -----------------------------
\usepackage[english]{babel}
\usepackage{csquotes}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{newtxtext,newtxmath}

%% ----------------------------- Layout & Spacing -----------------------------
\usepackage[a4paper,left=25mm,right=25mm,top=25mm,bottom=25mm,headheight=14pt,footskip=12mm]{geometry}
\usepackage{setspace}
\onehalfspacing
\usepackage{indentfirst}      % indent first paragraph after headings
\setlength{\parindent}{1.5em} % indent size
\setlength{\parskip}{0pt}     % keep paragraphs tight

%% ----------------------------- Figures & Tables -----------------------------
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{float}
\usepackage{caption}
\usepackage{subcaption}
\usepackage{longtable}
\usepackage{booktabs}
\usepackage{multirow}
\usepackage[table]{xcolor}

%% ----------------------------- Math, Units, URLs -----------------------------
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage{xurl}
\usepackage{siunitx}

%% ----------------------------- Code Listings -----------------------------
\usepackage{listings}
\lstset{
  basicstyle=\small\ttfamily,
  numbers=left,
  numberstyle=\scriptsize\ttfamily,
  numbersep=8pt,
  frame=tb,
  float=htb,
  aboveskip=6mm,
  belowskip=3mm,
  backgroundcolor=\color{black!2},
  showstringspaces=false,
  breaklines=true,
  tabsize=2,
  captionpos=t
}

%% ----------------------------- Header / Footer -----------------------------
%% \ccsitCollege and \gpTitleShort are defined in ccsit-macros.tex, which
%% main.tex loads after this file. That is fine: fancyhdr expands them at
%% page shipout.

\usepackage{fancyhdr}
\pagestyle{fancy}
\fancyhf{}
\lhead{\small \ccsitCollege}
\rhead{\small \textit{\gpTitleShort}}
\cfoot{\small \thepage}
\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0.2pt}
\renewcommand{\footrulewidth}{0pt}

%% ----------------------------- Hyperref -----------------------------
\usepackage{hyperref}
\hypersetup{
  colorlinks=true,
  linkcolor=blue!40!black,
  urlcolor=blue!40!black,
  citecolor=blue!40!black
}

%% ----------------------------- Acronyms -----------------------------
\usepackage{acronym}

%% ----------------------------- Bibliography (IEEE style) -----------------------------
\usepackage[backend=biber,style=ieee]{biblatex}
\addbibresource{bibliography.bib}

%% ----------------------------- Graphics path -----------------------------
\graphicspath{{figures/}}

%% ----------------------------- Numbered Sections (Not Chapters) -----------------------------
\makeatletter
\renewcommand{\thesection}{\arabic{section}}
\renewcommand{\thesubsection}{\thesection.\arabic{subsection}}
\renewcommand{\thesubsubsection}{\thesubsection.\arabic{subsubsection}}
\makeatother

\setcounter{secnumdepth}{3}
